Indian summers can be brutal — and your pet feels it too. The AvoCool Mat is a pressure-activated self-cooling gel mat designed to keep your dog or cat comfortably cool without electricity, water, or refrigeration. Just lay it flat, let your pet settle in, and the cooling begins instantly.

Why Pets Love the AvoCool Mat
Instant Pressure-Activated Cooling — Gel stays cool on contact and maintains a cooler temperature throughout use.
No Electricity Required — Completely self-contained; safe for indoor and outdoor use.
Lightweight & Foldable — Rolls up easily for travel, road trips, vet visits, or holidays.
Easy to Clean — Wipe down or hand wash; quick-drying surface.
Playful Avocado Print — Because staying cool should look good too.
Perfect For

Golden Retrievers, Labradors, Cocker Spaniels, Indie dogs, and cats of all sizes — especially breeds prone to overheating. Ideal for use at home, in the car, on the balcony, or at pet-friendly events.

Available Sizes
L — Suited for small to medium breeds
XL — Suited for large breeds and multi-pet households

Give your pet the gift of cool comfort this summer. The AvoCool Mat is your easiest, most stylish solution to pet heat relief in India.
